# Smile Center For Kids

> > Premier pediatric dental practice in El Paso, TX offering comprehensive children's dental care from infants through teens with specialized services including orthodontics, sedation dentistry, and special needs treatment.

Smile Center For Kids is a 5-star rated pediatric dental office serving El Paso and surrounding areas including Sunland, Edgemere, Horizon, Fabens, and Clint, Texas. The practice is led by Dr. Robert G. Wilson and Dr. Greg Wilson, with a bilingual team providing family-friendly dental care and accepting Medicaid.
